name: OmaLint
author: David Gudovic
description: Finds problems in your Omarchy shell plugins and bar setup: broken manifests, dead bar entries, keybinding conflicts, missing dependencies, modified plugins, and plugin errors in the shell log. Read-only unless you ask it to fix.

barWidget.description: Shows how many plugin and bar problems OmaLint found. Click for the report.

schema.label: Always Show
schema.description: Keep the icon on the bar when no problems are found.
